results: PositiveSquaredGapMomentBound proves the quantitative absolute-row bound: the sum of norm(m*u_m) is at most its ACTUAL finite low block plus3*C*norm(gap)^2 for any squared-full-l2-gap signed reciprocal tail estimate. Both diagonal and low terms are unrestricted. The exact factor3 follows from m*(1/abs(n-m)+1/(n+m))<=3 for m>2*n; the full integer-lattice l2 norm bounds the positive-index squared-gap sum.

PositiveSummableAnalyticAssembly constructs an ACTUAL Coeff1 realization of every absolutely summable positive-index sequence, with exact coefficients, EXACT l1 norm equal to the positive absolute sum, and exact total complex sum. For scalar analytic coordinates with locally bounded absolute sums, the map into Coeff1 is FULL Banach-source analytic by the verified bounded-coordinate Taylor assembly theorem. Applying the continuous linear summation functional proves full analyticity of the literal positive-index infinite series. Pointwise absolute convergence is not used as an analyticity certificate.

HillPrimitiveMomentSeriesNeighborhood packages the NOW PROVED actual spectral tail bounds on a common open native complex source, and its factory constructs such a neighborhood at EVERY real original source of EVERY retained family patch. The actual normalized weighted second moments define a literal Coeff1 row and the raw weighted series is DEFINED as sum_m m*ACTUAL centeredMoment(P,W,n,m,1,q). Its exact relation to the l1 row retains the factor2*pi; no replacement moments or assumed analytic sum data are introduced.

HillPrimitiveMomentSeriesLocalBound proves the full absolute-row sum is LOCALLY BOUNDED at EVERY COMPLEX point of the common neighborhood, including collapsed gaps. The actual gap-sequence local norm bound controls the tail; continuity of the finitely many ACTUAL analytic low moments controls the head. HillPrimitiveMomentSeriesAnalytic consequently proves FULL Banach-source analyticity of BOTH the ACTUAL Coeff1 row and its literal raw weighted infinite sum for EVERY row n on the SAME neighborhood. The series agrees across different primitive ambient neighborhoods within the SAME product/Miura patch.

HillPrimitiveMomentSeriesCompactConvergence defines ACTUAL finite positive-index moment partial sums through zero extension and literal symmetric integer truncation. Every coefficient is identified with its ACTUAL contour moment after the exact2*pi normalization. Continuity of the analytic l1 row proves the ACTUAL partial sums converge UNIFORMLY on EVERY compact complex source subset to the LITERAL raw infinite series. No fixed-open-Banach-ball uniform-tail claim is made or needed for the separately proved analytic assembly.

OriginalHillMomentSeriesAnalytic constructs the retained family and neighborhood at EVERY ORIGINAL real mean-zero rough Fourier source. ONE open complex neighborhood is chosen BEFORE ALL row indices, and supports actual Coeff1-row analyticity, scalar raw-series analyticity and compact uniform convergence of actual partial sums for every row. Weighted ALL-row ell(-1,r) bounds, equality of the sum with genuine H1 Hamiltonian frequency, and gluing across DIFFERENT Miura/product patches remain OPEN. Main1.4 and Appendix B remain COMPLETE; Main1.1,1.3,5.1,5.9 remain UNPROVED and goalACTIVE.
